sentence: She was on cloud nine after passing the exam
explanation: 'On cloud nine' significa extremadamente feliz. 'After' va seguido de un gerundio (forma -ing).

sentence: He always gets cold feet before important meetings
hint: Adverb of frequency before the main verb
explanation: 'Get cold feet' significa ponerse nervioso. Con 'he', usa 'gets'. 'Always' va antes del verbo.

sentence: We had to bite the bullet and sell the car
explanation: 'Bite the bullet' significa enfrentar una situación difícil con valentía. 'Had to' expresa obligación en el pasado.

sentence: The news spread like wildfire across the town
explanation: 'Spread like wildfire' significa propagarse muy rápido. 'Spread' es igual en todos los tiempos verbales.

sentence: She has been burning the midnight oil all week
explanation: 'Burn the midnight oil' significa trabajar hasta muy tarde en la noche. El presente perfecto continuo muestra una acción en curso.

sentence: They decided to call it a day after lunch
explanation: 'Call it a day' significa dejar de trabajar. 'Decided to' va seguido de la forma base.

sentence: I think we should not beat around the bush
hint: Subject + think + clause with should not
explanation: 'Beat around the bush' significa evitar el tema principal. 'Should not' va antes del verbo.

sentence: He was feeling blue because he missed his family
explanation: 'Feeling blue' significa sentirse triste. 'Because' introduce la razón.

sentence: The project cost us an arm and a leg last year
explanation: 'Cost an arm and a leg' significa ser muy caro. 'Cost' es igual en todos los tiempos verbales.

sentence: You should not put all your eggs in one basket
explanation: 'Put all your eggs in one basket' significa arriesgarlo todo en una sola opción. 'Should not' va antes de la forma base.

sentence: He told a joke to break the ice
explanation: 'Break the ice' significa hacer que la gente se sienta más cómoda en una situación social.

sentence: If you wait too long you will miss the boat
explanation: 'Miss the boat' significa perder una oportunidad por actuar demasiado lento.

sentence: Let us make sure we are on the same page
explanation: 'On the same page' significa estar de acuerdo con alguien o entender algo de la misma manera.

sentence: We should hit the road before it gets dark
explanation: 'Hit the road' significa partir o comenzar un viaje.

sentence: She wanted to get the ball rolling on the new project
explanation: 'Get the ball rolling' significa poner algo en marcha.
